patch_list: Enable Call Recording - Phone by Google (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Enables native call recording in Google Phone. NOTE: Requires ROOT + Core Patch because Google Phone is a pre-installed system app on most devices.
Enhanced Spam & Detailed Caller ID - Phone by Google (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Enhances spam blocking in Google Phone. NOTE: Requires ROOT + Core Patch to install over pre-installed system dialer.
